name: CSAT and Knowledge Loop Operator
description: Measures satisfaction honestly, chases the worst-scoring ticket classes, and turns a repeated unanswered problem into a written knowledge article so it stops being asked.

workflow.name: CSAT and Knowledge Loop Operator
workflow.description: Measures satisfaction honestly, chases the worst-scoring ticket classes, and turns a repeated unanswered problem into a written knowledge article so it stops being asked.

inputs.name: onedrive_folder
inputs.description: The OneDrive folder containing the CSV exports.
inputs.label: OneDrive Folder

inputs.name: github_repo
inputs.description: The GitHub repository to create draft knowledge articles in.
inputs.label: GitHub Repository

inputs.name: poor_score_threshold
inputs.description: A satisfaction score at or below this triggers a follow-up.
inputs.label: Poor Score Threshold

inputs.name: knowledge_gap_min_tickets
inputs.description: Number of tickets of one class with no matching article before one is drafted.
inputs.label: Knowledge Gap Min Tickets

steps.name: Load and Join Data
steps.description: Download required CSV files from OneDrive, normalize data, and join survey/requester information.
steps.agent_prompt: Use the Microsoft OneDrive API via MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_TOKEN to list and download CSV exports (issues, satisfaction-survey, knowledge-base, users) from user_inputs["onedrive_folder"]. Check for existence; raise an explicit error if issues, satisfaction-survey, or knowledge-base are missing, but proceed with a warning if users is missing. Load into pandas DataFrames. Normalize: drop byte-identical duplicate rows, deduplicate by key (keep newest), and parse the 'created' column dates tolerantly (ISO, abbreviated month, then slash-dates resolving to maximize range). Join surveys to tickets by ticket key. Join requesters by account identifier only. If a requester resolves to 0 or >1 accounts, do not act on it (add to warnings). Treat blank CSAT scores as non-responses (np.nan), not zeros. Pass the processed DataFrames to the next step.

steps.name: Score by Ticket Class
steps.description: Cluster tickets by underlying problem using LLM and compute metrics per class.
steps.agent_prompt: Receive the joined DataFrames. Group tickets into classes by the underlying problem being reported using call_ai_llm to cluster on meaning (language-agnostic, do not use fixed keywords). Every ticket must be assigned to a cluster or explicitly marked as unclustered. Compute per class: ticket volume, average satisfaction (excluding non-responses), poor score count (<= user_inputs["poor_score_threshold"]), non-response count, breach count, distinct requesters, and whether any KB article matches. Rank classes by damage (volume weighted by breaches and poor scores). Save the clustered results and computations for the next step.

steps.name: Branch on Class Needs
steps.description: Determine the appropriate action (treatment) for each clustered ticket class.
steps.agent_prompt: Assign each clustered class from the previous step exactly one treatment based on the data: 'KNOWLEDGE_GAP' if tickets >= user_inputs["knowledge_gap_min_tickets"] and no specific article exists (generic titles don't count); 'ARTICLE_INEFFECTIVE' if an article exists but satisfaction is poor; 'FOLLOW_UP_REQUIRED' for individual tickets at or below user_inputs["poor_score_threshold"]; 'HEALTHY' otherwise. Record the evidence and pass the mapped treatments to the next step.

steps.name: Take Action (Drafts)
steps.description: Draft knowledge articles in GitHub and follow-up emails in Outlook (Draft mode only).
steps.agent_prompt: Execute actions based on assigned treatments. For KNOWLEDGE_GAP classes: Use GitHub API with GITHUB_TOKEN to search user_inputs["github_repo"] for existing drafts for this class to avoid duplicates. If none exist, draft a new article containing symptoms, observed root cause, resolution steps, and owning team. Mark as requiring human approval. For FOLLOW_UP_REQUIRED tickets: Detect the requester's language from the ticket text using call_ai_llm. Use Microsoft Outlook API with MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_TOKEN to create a DRAFT message (do NOT send) for each affected requester, acknowledging the experience, stating action, and asking one question. For ARTICLE_INEFFECTIVE classes: Note the rewrite request with evidence. Return all proposed actions.

steps.name: Structured Output
steps.description: Generate final structured output and summary report.
steps.agent_prompt: Format the final results into a structured JSON object containing: 'classes', 'csat' (overall stats excluding non-responses), 'drafted_articles', 'follow_ups', 'rewrite_requests', 'elimination_forecast', 'exceptions', and 'warnings'. Ensure blank scores are not represented as zeros. Print a short, readable summary to stdout. Produce the final JSON object.
